tasks.label: ▶ Start MacOS Frontend + Backend
tasks.detail: Runs the main MacOS web frontend and the shared backend together

tasks.label: 🏷️ Bump Version (Patch) & Push Tags
tasks.command: npm version patch && git push origin main --tags
tasks.detail: Bumps patch version (e.g. 1.1.0 -> 1.1.1), creates git tag, and pushes to GitHub

tasks.label: 🏷️ Bump Version (Minor) & Push Tags
tasks.command: npm version minor && git push origin main --tags
tasks.detail: Bumps minor version for new features (e.g. 1.1.0 -> 1.2.0) and pushes tags

tasks.label: 🚀 Deploy to Ubuntu (Dry Run via Script)
tasks.detail: Tests connection and builds without modifying production

tasks.label: 🚀 Deploy to Ubuntu (Live via Script)
tasks.detail: Builds and syncs files directly from your PC to Ubuntu VM

tasks.label: ⬆️ Git Push (origin main)
tasks.detail: Pushes local commits on main branch to GitHub

tasks.label: ▶ Start Zentra Frontend + Backend
tasks.detail: Runs the Zentra dashboard plus the shared MacOS backend

tasks.label: ▶ Start All 3: MacOS + Zentra + Backend
tasks.command: concurrently "npm run backend" "npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173" "npm --prefix zentra-analytics-dashboard run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000"
tasks.detail: Starts the shared backend, the main MacOS interface, and the Zentra alternative frontend together
